summary.name: Tarteel
summary.one_liner: Tarteel is an AI-powered Quran memorization and recitation app that detects recitation mistakes in real time.
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Tarteel as an AI app for Quran memorization. Its flagship feature, Mistake Detection, listens to the user's recitation and flags missed, incorrect, and skipped words in real time. Memorization Planning offers tools to tailor a memorization schedule to the user's learning style and preferences. Goals let users set targets and track progress while memorizing. The listing also describes translations, word highlighting, and customizable challenges. The page links to the re:Verses podcast and cites over 100,000 five-star reviews.
notable: Real-time detection of missed, incorrect and skipped words during recitation
Memorization planning tools tailored to learning style
Goal setting and progress tracking for memorization
Companion re:Verses podcast with Qari guests
caveats: Features are described as part of Tarteel Premium, implying a paid tier; specific prices are not stated on the page
Supported platforms are not named in the page text
